tasks.short: Write and revise safety regulations and codes

steps.what: Read the actual governing sources, current code version and revision request and determine the applicable drafting scope
inputs: Actual current source requirements and code text
Owner's revision request and drafting authority
outputs: Engineer-verified sources, scope and required changes

steps.what: Determine and author the actual technical substance of new or revised safety provisions and their rationale
inputs: Verified source requirements and revision scope
Actual process and hazard knowledge
outputs: Engineer-authored provisions, rationale and source references

steps.what: Assemble exact unchanged clauses, selected revised provisions, numbering and source-reference fields into the controlled draft
inputs: Actual current clauses from s1
Engineer-authored revised provisions from s2
Explicit document structure
outputs: Traceable assembled draft with revision differences

steps.what: Write and revise explanatory wording and consistency while preserving the engineer's exact substantive provisions
inputs: Assembled draft and engineer-authored substance
Verified source passages and stated rationale
outputs: Complete edited code draft with unresolved wording marked

loop.purpose: Improve wording consistency without creating or changing an obligation
loop.input: Actual engineer-authored provisions, rationale and verified sources
loop.output: Proposed wording edits with unchanged technical meaning
loop.check: Engineer checks every edit against intended duties, limits and source passages
loop.stop: Stop on changed obligation, missing basis or unresolved interpretation and return to engineer authoring
loop.why_not_simpler: The variable explanatory wording needs semantic editing after fixed numbering and clause assembly

steps.what: Check the complete final draft and revision differences for technical meaning, source support and drafting scope
inputs: Complete edited draft
Original sources, provisions and intended revision
outputs: Exact checked final code draft with actual approval status

steps.what: Save the exact checked safety-code draft and revision record
inputs: Exact complete final draft checked in s5
outputs: Saved draft safety regulation or code and revision record

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} controlled-document assembly, numbering and version differences, then use a bounded wording loop for engineer-authored provisions. The engineer checks every meaning change and the complete final draft before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual clause assembly and wording consistency can repeat work already captured in the revision decision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document fields and comparisons handle exact structure; a bounded prose loop can suggest edits to already-authored substance.
tasks.still_hard: Determining obligations and whether they fit actual hazards and authority requires professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Own the technical provisions and recognise when wording changes their effect.

ambition.what: Improve existing safety-code drafting and revision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled-document fields and revision comparisons can assemble exact clauses, and source-bound prose editing can assist wording with human meaning checks.

assumptions: Conditional engineering drafting episode with actual manual assembly and editing, not a measured baseline. Governing-source owners produce source texts; engineer reading, applicability and substantive authoring are fully counted in s1-s2.
Native document configuration first. Existing numbering, templates and comparisons are baseline and earn no new saving. No free pre-authored safety content or model-created obligation.

Only explanatory wording uses the semantic loop. Missing authority, contradictory sources or altered meaning stop it; engineer source/meaning checks are included in s4 and complete final checking in s5.

This writes and revises the code text within the engineer's actual drafting remit. Saving a draft does not enact a law or issue an operational rule; any required legal, employee or management approval must inspect the completed final version before a separate publication/send, with its labour added.
Same-system save is negligible and fully retained. No hidden distribution or regulatory filing.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross assembly 20 plus wording saving 8 equals 28, less upkeep 4 gives net 24.
unknowns: Actual code ownership, native document features and approval requirements
research_questions: Which assembly and semantic editing remain manual after existing controlled-document features?

already_counted.description: Source applicability and substantive provision authoring, retained wording/meaning checks and complete final review

incremental.description: Maintain controlled-document mappings and evaluate wording-loop failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete code draft and revision record checked in s5; any edit requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual assembly and wording scenario: gross 28 less upkeep 4; substantive requirements and final review retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with medical professionals on health risks and management

steps.what: Find and verify the actual occupational-health question and relevant authorized exposure or workplace evidence
inputs: Actual consultation question
Existing exposure and workplace records in the safety system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Checked context and evidence limitations

steps.what: Confer with medical professionals to assess actual health risks and develop ways to manage health issues and concerns
inputs: Checked workplace context
Medical professionals' actual expertise and concerns
outputs: Human consultation findings and proposed management measures

steps.what: Capture the actual required workplace risk-management note and check its full wording, uncertainties and appropriate information scope
inputs: Actual consultation findings and proposals from s2
outputs: Complete checked management note with clinical responsibilities distinguished

steps.what: Save the exact checked risk-management note
inputs: Exact complete note checked in s3
outputs: Saved consultation-derived workplace note

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} workplace-evidence views and fixed note fields. The engineer retains the medical consultation, captures its actual findings and checks the complete appropriately scoped note before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence navigation and repeated context fields can consume preparation and recording effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and forms can reduce navigation and fixed-field entry.
tasks.still_hard: Health risk interpretation and management responsibilities require professional collaboration.
tasks.human_edge: Connect workplace conditions with medical expertise without assuming clinical authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native safety-record views and fixed fields can support consultation administration while risk and clinical judgements remain with professionals.

assumptions: Conditional consultation with an actual existing workplace note, not invented documentation after every conversation or a measured baseline.

Workplace record owners produce source evidence; engineer retrieval, context checking and actual consultation capture are counted in s1-s3. Medical professionals' consultation remains human and no saving in their labour is claimed.
Native features first; existing views and forms earn zero new saving. s3 reduces fixed context identifiers only; all substantive writing and complete final checking remain.

No generated clinical opinion, employee medical conclusion, treatment instruction or automatic management action. Any proposed measure requiring authorization must be checked in its final form by the actual owner before a separate action.
Same-system save is negligible and fully retained. All 100 illustrative focal points: gross 2.25 plus 2.4 equals 4.65, less upkeep 1 gives net 3.65.
unknowns: Actual workplace-note requirements and authorized evidence scope
research_questions: Which context navigation and fixed identifiers remain manual without extending access to clinical records?

already_counted.description: Retained context checks and actual consultation-note capture, scope and final verification

incremental.description: Maintain authorized source views and fixed note fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete appropriately scoped note checked in s3; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional lookup and fixed-field saving 4.65 less upkeep 1; actual risk discussion and clinical judgement retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Determine the actual equipment purpose, hazards, constraints and established design/build requirements
inputs: Actual equipment need and operating context
Existing applicable requirement and workshop sources
outputs: Engineer-authored design and construction requirements

steps.what: Design the safety equipment's actual function, form and construction details
inputs: Actual requirements from s1
Existing engineering CAD tool, defined as OTHER
outputs: Engineer-authored equipment design

steps.what: Construct repeated drawing details and dimensions from the engineer's explicit geometry
inputs: Engineer-authored exact geometry from s2
outputs: Complete editable equipment drawing

steps.what: Check the complete final design and actual readiness to build that exact version under established workshop procedures
inputs: Complete equipment design
Actual materials, workshop conditions and applicable construction requirements
outputs: Exact checked design and build-readiness decision or a hold

steps.what: Save the exact checked equipment design
inputs: Exact design checked in s4
outputs: Saved controlled design version

steps.what: Build the actual equipment to the checked design using established methods and inspect the actual construction
inputs: Exact final design and build readiness checked in s4
Actual materials and workshop tools
outputs: Physically built equipment and observed construction conformity or unresolved defects

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} CAD repetition and dimensions for engineer-authored geometry. The engineer retains equipment design, checks the final design and actual build readiness, saves it and builds and inspects the equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated drawing geometry can consume some design-document effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native CAD features can reproduce explicitly specified drawing details.
tasks.still_hard: Safety function and actual construction quality require engineering and workshop judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Evaluate the equipment's intended function and recognise construction defects.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native CAD features can reduce repeated geometric drawing while equipment design and physical construction remain human work.

assumptions: Conditional small equipment episode actually designed and built by the focal engineer, not a measured baseline or an assertion that engineers always fabricate equipment themselves.

Engineer requirements and design inputs are authored and counted in s1-s2. No free completed design or generated safety function. Native CAD features first; existing repeated-geometry automation earns no new saving.
s4 is ordinary final-design and build-readiness work after the complete design exists. Any design, material or condition change requires rechecking before the affected save/build action.
Physical construction and inspection remain fully retained in s6. No new construction method, fabrication parameter, machine automation or substitute material is supplied.

Building does not silently commission or certify equipment for use; actual acceptance or operational release requires the appropriate owner to review final as-built evidence before a separate action, with that work added if in scope.
Save is negligible and fully retained. All 100 illustrative focal points: gross drawing saving 3 less upkeep 1 gives net 2.
unknowns: Actual fabrication labour allocation and current CAD features
research_questions: Which repeated drawing details still require manual construction after native CAD tools?

already_counted.description: Actual requirements and design, retained geometric setup/review and full final design/build readiness checking

incremental.description: Maintain and validate reusable CAD features

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete equipment design checked in s4; edits require recheck
Exact design and actual build readiness checked in s4; changed design, material or conditions require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional repeated drawing saving 3 minus upkeep 1; full safety design and physical construction retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect facilities and equipment and correct actual hazards

steps.what: Find and check actual inspection scope, applicable requirements and existing facility or equipment information
inputs: Actual inspection assignment
Owner-maintained requirements and asset records in the safety/maintenance system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Checked inspection context and current source requirements

steps.what: Inspect the actual facility, machinery or safety equipment and capture observations to identify hazards and assess conformity
inputs: Actual facility or equipment
Checked requirements
outputs: Actual captured observations, hazards and unresolved conformity questions

steps.what: Determine appropriate corrective measures and distinguish routine authorized correction from issues needing another responsible owner
inputs: Actual inspection findings
Established procedures and actual authority
outputs: Human-selected corrective disposition and unresolved owner decisions

steps.what: Check the exact routine corrective action and actual readiness against established procedure and authority
inputs: Specific selected routine correction from s3
Actual site conditions and authority
outputs: Checked exact correction and readiness or a hold

steps.what: Perform the exact checked routine correction within actual authority and observe the resulting condition
inputs: Exact correction and readiness checked in s4
outputs: Actual corrected condition or unresolved hazard

steps.what: Write the actual inspection and correction record and check its full observations, remaining hazards and status
inputs: Actual inspection observations
Actual corrective result from s5 and unresolved dispositions
outputs: Complete checked inspection record with no unsupported closure

steps.what: Save the exact checked inspection and correction record
inputs: Exact complete record checked in s6
outputs: Saved inspection and actual corrective status

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} and {OPS_SYSTEM} source links for inspection preparation. The engineer retains inspection, corrective decisions and physical correction, then writes and checks the actual record before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct requirement and asset context can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset and document links can reduce that lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising hazards and choosing an appropriate actual correction require site judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Assess changing conditions and distinguish resolved hazards from issues still needing action.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native asset/document links can reduce inspection-context lookup while physical inspection and hazard correction remain human work.

assumptions: Representative inspection with an actual required record and a routine correction performed by the engineer under existing authority; not a measured baseline for major repairs or every inspection.
Asset and requirement owners produce source records. Engineer source checks, observation capture, actual corrective decisions and record writing are counted in s1-s6. No free structured hazard feed.
Native features first; existing links earn zero new saving. No generated correction procedure, control parameter or automatic compliance verdict.

s4 is ordinary readiness checking for the exact real correction. Changed conditions or action require rechecking. Corrections outside actual authority remain open for the responsible owner; any actual escalation message or repair order must be added as a separate final-checked send/commit, with all labour included.
The record is written after the actual correction result exists; no automatic hazard closure. Save is negligible and fully retained.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross lookup saving 2 less upkeep 1 gives net 1.
unknowns: Actual inspection-record process and distribution of routine versus specialist corrections
research_questions: Which preparation navigation remains manual, and which corrections require another actor's work?

already_counted.description: Retained source checks, exact corrective readiness checking and actual final-record writing/checking

incremental.description: Maintain asset and requirement source links

approvals.approved_version: Exact routine correction and readiness checked in s4 under current conditions; changes require recheck
Exact complete post-correction record checked in s6; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional source-lookup saving 2 less upkeep 1; physical inspection, correction and actual record work retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Maintain native controlled documents and CAD features
Distinguish actual authority and unresolved hazard status
role.ambitious_version: The engineer handles explicit document and drawing repetition with less effort while retaining safety substance, professional consultation and physical hazard decisions.

job.title: Health and Safety Engineers, Except Mining Safety Engineers and Inspectors
